# Contract: Reopen

*Generated by spec-writer. Hand edits are overwritten on regeneration.*

## Prerequisites

These conditions describe the environment in which items in this
contract are exercised. Producing them is part of the feature's
deliverable, alongside the implementation itself — a contract whose
prerequisites are not yet satisfied is not failing, it is still being
built. Once the feature is delivered, any missing condition halts item
execution until it is restored.

**Runtime services:**
- Docker Engine with Compose v2 is installed and its daemon is running
- `uv` is on PATH and can provision Python 3.12; backend dependencies are installed with `uv sync` in `backend/`
- a PostgreSQL 17 server with the `vector` extension available (the `db` service of `docker-compose.yml`) is running and healthy
- the database reached through the supplied database URL has its schema initialized (application tables present, `vector` extension installed) and holds no rows unless a Persistent state entry or an item says otherwise; each item starts from a database holding only the entries its `given` names
- a stand-in for the OpenAI API is running on a loopback port it chooses and reports when it starts; it is delivered by earlier features (under `backend/tests/mocks/`) and is described under External dependencies

**Persistent state:**
- bug `triaged-bug` has status `processed`, title "Checkout button does nothing on Safari 17", description "Clicking Place order shows no response and no network call.", reproduction steps "Add an item, go to checkout in Safari 17, click the button.", system version "web 3.8.2", environment `production` and reporting team `support`. It has one run of type `triage` for this bug with status `succeeded` and progress 5 of 5, five run steps with positions 1 to 5 all `succeeded`, at least three run log lines, one embedding row (a 1,536-dimension vector with a text hash), and exactly one row in each of the component, severity, analysis, plan and report tables, all referencing that run; the report row has non-empty Markdown and HTML text. Used by `SVC-REOPEN-01`, `SVC-REOPEN-02`, `SVC-REOPEN-03`, `SVC-CONCURRENT-01`, `SVC-ATOMIC-01`, `SVC-ATOMIC-02`, `SVC-RETRIAGE-01`, `CLI-REOPEN-01`, `CLI-REOPEN-02`, `CLI-REOPEN-03`, `CLI-REOPEN-04`, `CLI-REOPEN-09`.
- bug `neighbor-bug` has the same shape as `triaged-bug` (status `processed`, its own run, five steps, log lines, embedding row and one row in each result table) except that its title is "Neighbor bug". Used by `SVC-REOPEN-03`.
- bug `failed-triaged-bug` has status `failed` and the field values of `triaged-bug` except for its title "Failed checkout bug". It has one run of type `triage` for this bug with status `failed` and a non-empty error, five run steps (positions 1 and 2 `succeeded`, position 3 `failed` with an error, positions 4 and 5 `skipped`), at least three run log lines and one embedding row; it has no row in any of the five result tables. Used by `SVC-REOPEN-04`, `SVC-ATOMIC-03`, `CLI-REOPEN-05`.
- bug `busy-bug` has status `processing` and the field values of `triaged-bug` except for its title "Busy checkout bug". It has one run of type `triage` for this bug with status `running`, five run steps (position 1 `running`, positions 2 to 5 `pending`) and one run log line; it has no embedding row and no row in any of the five result tables. Used by `SVC-REJECT-01`, `CLI-REOPEN-06`.
- bug `untriaged-bug` has status `open` and the field values of `triaged-bug` except for its title "Fresh checkout bug"; it has no run, no embedding row and no row in any of the five result tables. Used by `SVC-REJECT-02`, `CLI-REOPEN-07`.
- no bug has the id 999999. Used by `SVC-REJECT-03`, `CLI-REOPEN-08`.

**Configuration:**
- for service items that triage, the LLM client is built with the stand-in's `/v1` URL as an explicit base URL, the key `sk-test-valid`, a 60-second timeout, 2 retries, the embedding model `text-embedding-3-small` and the chat model `gpt-4o-mini`; the number of similar bugs passed to the Technical Analyst is the default 5; settings can be built with the root `.env` file disabled. Used by `SVC-RETRIAGE-01`.
- for CLI items the configuration comes only from the process environment: `DATABASE_URL` is set explicitly, no other BugFlow variable is set, and no root `.env` file exists; the `reopen` command needs no API key.
- a reopen hook that always fails with the error text "forced failure" can be registered through the feature's hook registration. Used by `SVC-ATOMIC-01`, `SVC-ATOMIC-03`.
- a reopen hook that, when it runs, records the bug status and the row count of each of the five result tables for the bug as seen by the transaction it is given, and the same observations as seen from a separate database connection, plus how often it ran, can be registered through the feature's hook registration. Used by `SVC-ATOMIC-02`.
- no reopen hook is registered unless an item says so.
- `TZ=UTC`

**External dependencies:**
- the OpenAI API is replaced by a local stand-in delivered by earlier features. It answers embedding requests with deterministic 1,536-dimension vectors and accepts only the key `sk-test-valid`; it answers each triage agent chat request with a valid JSON object chosen by the agent role named in the request's system message, so a triage of a bug completes with all five agents succeeding. No item needs network access or a real API key. Used by `SVC-RETRIAGE-01`.
- the container image `pgvector/pgvector:pg17` is either already present locally or can be pulled from its registry

## Quality gates

Each gate must pass for the feature to be considered ready. All commands run from `backend/`.

- **Format** — `uv run ruff format .` — completes with exit code 0 and leaves the source tree formatted
- **Lint** — `uv run ruff check .` — completes with exit code 0 and reports no violations
- **Tests** — `uv run pytest` — completes with exit code 0; every non-integration test passes

## Coverage Manifest

| PRD Acceptance Criterion | Covered by |
|---|---|
| Reopening a `processed` bug deletes its component, severity, analysis, plan and report rows and sets status `open`; its runs and run steps remain | SVC-REOPEN-01, SVC-REOPEN-02, SVC-REOPEN-03, CLI-REOPEN-02 |
| Reopening a `failed` bug sets it `open` | SVC-REOPEN-04, CLI-REOPEN-05 |
| Reopening a `processing` or already `open` bug is rejected and changes nothing | SVC-REJECT-01, SVC-REJECT-02, SVC-REJECT-03, SVC-CONCURRENT-01, CLI-REOPEN-06, CLI-REOPEN-07, CLI-REOPEN-08 |
| An error during deletion rolls back everything | SVC-ATOMIC-01, SVC-ATOMIC-02, SVC-ATOMIC-03 |
| `bugflow reopen <id>` without confirmation deletes nothing; with `--yes` it reopens | CLI-REOPEN-01, CLI-REOPEN-02, CLI-REOPEN-03, CLI-REOPEN-04 |
| After reopening, a new triage can run and produces a new run alongside the old one | SVC-RETRIAGE-01 |

## Service

**Verification mode:** Invoke the public function directly in-process on an initialized database, using the engine the function takes; assert the returned value, thrown error, persisted side-effect, or the observations recorded by a registered hook.

*Consumers outside this feature: F09 (API, Operations and Parity) consumes `reopen_bug`, as declared in PRD Section 8.*

### Reopen a bug

**Common given:** no reopen hook is registered.

#### `SVC-REOPEN-01` — a processed bug is reopened and its results are deleted
- given: `triaged-bug` exists
- when: call `reopen_bug` for `triaged-bug` with the engine
- then:
  - the returned bug has status `open` and no component and no severity
  - the stored status of `triaged-bug` is `open`
  - no row exists for `triaged-bug` in any of the component, severity, analysis, plan and report tables
  - the stored `updated_at` of `triaged-bug` is later than before the call

#### `SVC-REOPEN-02` — run history and embeddings are kept
- given: `triaged-bug` exists
- when: call `reopen_bug` for `triaged-bug`
- then:
  - its run still exists with unchanged status, progress and timestamps
  - its five run steps still exist with unchanged status, input and output
  - its run log lines are all still present and unchanged
  - its embedding row is unchanged
  - the number of rows in the `runs` table is the same as before the call

#### `SVC-REOPEN-03` — other bugs are not affected
- given: `triaged-bug` and `neighbor-bug` exist
- when: call `reopen_bug` for `triaged-bug`
- then:
  - the stored status of `neighbor-bug` is still `processed`
  - `neighbor-bug` still has exactly one row in each of the component, severity, analysis, plan and report tables
  - the run, steps, logs and embedding of `neighbor-bug` are unchanged

#### `SVC-REOPEN-04` — a failed bug is reopened
- given: `failed-triaged-bug` exists
- when: call `reopen_bug` for `failed-triaged-bug` with the engine
- then:
  - the returned bug has status `open`
  - the stored status of `failed-triaged-bug` is `open`
  - its run, five run steps, run log lines and embedding row are unchanged

### Rejected reopen

**Common given:** no reopen hook is registered.

#### `SVC-REJECT-01` — a processing bug is rejected
- given: `busy-bug` exists
- when: call `reopen_bug` for `busy-bug`
- then:
  - a state-conflict error is raised with the message "Bug <id> is being processed and cannot be reopened", where <id> is the id of `busy-bug`
  - the stored status and `updated_at` of `busy-bug` are unchanged
  - its run and its five run steps are unchanged

#### `SVC-REJECT-02` — an open bug is rejected
- given: `untriaged-bug` exists
- when: call `reopen_bug` for `untriaged-bug`
- then:
  - a state-conflict error is raised with the message "Bug <id> is already open", where <id> is the id of `untriaged-bug`
  - the stored status and `updated_at` of `untriaged-bug` are unchanged
  - the `runs` table holds no row

#### `SVC-REJECT-03` — an unknown bug
- given: no bug has the id 999999
- when: call `reopen_bug` for id 999999
- then:
  - a not-found error is raised with the message "Bug 999999 not found"

### Concurrent reopen

**Common given:** no reopen hook is registered.

#### `SVC-CONCURRENT-01` — simultaneous reopens have one winner
- given: `triaged-bug` exists
- when: call `reopen_bug` for `triaged-bug` from two concurrent callers at the same time
- then:
  - exactly one call returns the bug with status `open`
  - the other call raises a state-conflict error with the message "Bug <id> is already open", where <id> is the id of `triaged-bug`
  - the stored status is `open` and no result row remains for `triaged-bug`

### Atomic reopen

#### `SVC-ATOMIC-01` — a failure during the transaction rolls everything back
- given: `triaged-bug` exists; the always-failing reopen hook is registered
- when: call `reopen_bug` for `triaged-bug`
- then:
  - an error is raised with the message "Reopen of bug <id> failed; nothing was changed", where <id> is the id of `triaged-bug`
  - the stored status of `triaged-bug` is still `processed`
  - `triaged-bug` still has exactly one row in each of the component, severity, analysis, plan and report tables, with the values it had before the call
  - its run, five run steps, run log lines and embedding row are unchanged

#### `SVC-ATOMIC-02` — the changes are one transaction
- given: `triaged-bug` exists; the recording reopen hook is registered
- when: call `reopen_bug` for `triaged-bug`
- then:
  - the hook ran exactly once
  - inside the transaction the hook saw the status `open` and zero rows in each of the five result tables
  - from a separate connection the hook saw the status `processed` and one row in each of the five result tables
  - after the call returns, a new connection sees the status `open` and zero rows in each of the five result tables

#### `SVC-ATOMIC-03` — a failed bug is also restored on failure
- given: `failed-triaged-bug` exists; the always-failing reopen hook is registered
- when: call `reopen_bug` for `failed-triaged-bug`
- then:
  - an error is raised with the message "Reopen of bug <id> failed; nothing was changed", where <id> is the id of `failed-triaged-bug`
  - the stored status of `failed-triaged-bug` is still `failed`
  - its run, five run steps and run log lines are unchanged

### Triage after reopen

**Common given:** the stand-in answers every agent with its default valid reply; the client uses the configuration of the Prerequisites; no reopen hook is registered.

#### `SVC-RETRIAGE-01` — a reopened bug is triaged again with a new run
- given: `triaged-bug` exists and has been reopened by `reopen_bug`
- when: call `triage_bug` for `triaged-bug` with the engine and a client factory
- then:
  - the returned outcome has status `processed` and no error
  - exactly one row exists for `triaged-bug` in each of the component, severity, analysis, plan and report tables, and each references the run of the outcome
  - the run of the outcome differs from the run `triaged-bug` had before the reopen
  - the earlier run and its five run steps are unchanged
  - `triaged-bug` now has two runs of type `triage`

## CLI

**Verification mode:** Spawn the binary with the given arguments and stdin; assert stdout, stderr, exit code, and any direct persisted side-effect in the database the command targets.

### Help

#### `CLI-HELP-01` — the new command is listed
- given: (default)
- when: run `uv run bugflow --help` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is 0
  - stdout lists the command `reopen` with a one-line English description

### Reopen

**Common given:** the CLI environment of the Prerequisites.

#### `CLI-REOPEN-01` — reopen confirmed by typing
- given: `triaged-bug` exists
- when: run `uv run bugflow reopen <id>` from `backend/` with standard input "yes" followed by a newline, where <id> is the id of `triaged-bug`
- then:
  - exit code is 0
  - stdout contains the prompt "This deletes the results and report of bug <id>. Type 'yes' to continue:"
  - the last stdout line is "Bug <id> reopened"
  - the stored status of `triaged-bug` is `open`
  - no row exists for `triaged-bug` in any of the component, severity, analysis, plan and report tables

#### `CLI-REOPEN-02` — reopen with --yes
- given: `triaged-bug` exists
- when: run `uv run bugflow reopen <id> --yes` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is 0
  - stdout is exactly the line "Bug <id> reopened"
  - the stored status of `triaged-bug` is `open`
  - no row exists for `triaged-bug` in any of the component, severity, analysis, plan and report tables
  - the run and the five run steps of `triaged-bug` still exist

#### `CLI-REOPEN-03` — reopen refused by the answer
- given: `triaged-bug` exists
- when: run `uv run bugflow reopen <id>` from `backend/` with standard input "no" followed by a newline
- then:
  - exit code is 1
  - stdout contains "Aborted: nothing was deleted"
  - the stored status of `triaged-bug` is still `processed`
  - `triaged-bug` still has exactly one row in each of the component, severity, analysis, plan and report tables

#### `CLI-REOPEN-04` — reopen without any answer
- given: `triaged-bug` exists
- when: run `uv run bugflow reopen <id>` from `backend/` with standard input closed immediately
- then:
  - exit code is 1
  - stdout contains "Aborted: nothing was deleted"
  - the stored status of `triaged-bug` is still `processed`
  - `triaged-bug` still has exactly one row in each of the component, severity, analysis, plan and report tables

#### `CLI-REOPEN-05` — reopen a failed bug
- given: `failed-triaged-bug` exists
- when: run `uv run bugflow reopen <id> --yes` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is 0
  - the last stdout line is "Bug <id> reopened"
  - the stored status of `failed-triaged-bug` is `open`
  - its run and five run steps still exist

#### `CLI-REOPEN-06` — a processing bug is rejected
- given: `busy-bug` exists
- when: run `uv run bugflow reopen <id> --yes` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is 1
  - stderr contains "Bug <id> is being processed and cannot be reopened"
  - the stored status of `busy-bug` is still `processing`
  - its run and five run steps are unchanged

#### `CLI-REOPEN-07` — an open bug is rejected
- given: `untriaged-bug` exists
- when: run `uv run bugflow reopen <id> --yes` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is 1
  - stderr contains "Bug <id> is already open"
  - the stored status of `untriaged-bug` is still `open`

#### `CLI-REOPEN-08` — an unknown bug
- given: no bug has the id 999999
- when: run `uv run bugflow reopen 999999 --yes` from `backend/`
- then:
  - exit code is 1
  - stderr contains "Bug 999999 not found"

#### `CLI-REOPEN-09` — the id is required
- given: `triaged-bug` exists
- when: run `uv run bugflow reopen` from `backend/` with no argument
- then:
  - exit code is 2
  - stderr contains a usage message
  - the stored status of `triaged-bug` is still `processed`
